source: Pricing page (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing) and the Claude Haiku 5.5 model page, retrieved 2026-10-08: Haiku 5.5 (released October 7) is priced by prompt length, $0.10 input / $0.50 output per MTok, 5-minute cache writes $0.125, 1-hour cache writes $0.20 and cache reads $0.01 for prompts up to 100,000 tokens; five times that ($0.50 / $2.50 / $0.625 / $1 / $0.05) for prompts over 100,000 tokens. Stated rates, not derived; not invoice-reconciled. The pages don't say which tokens count toward the 100,000: these rates are applied on the whole prompt (uncached input, cache writes and cache reads; cache_probe.prompt_tokens), the rule Anthropic's earlier long-context prices used. Unconfirmed for Haiku 5.5.
